title: OpenComputer
claim: Product Hunt: OpenComputer — The easiest way to deploy a managed agent.
why_good: 'Easiest way to deploy a managed agent' — real pain as teams struggle to take agents from laptop to production.
value: Usage-based managed-agent hosting (the Vercel-for-agents lane); teams pay to not run agent infra themselves.
risk: Crowded managed-agent-hosting race (E2B, Modal, the labs); winning needs reliability + DX + price at scale.
evidence: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: OpenComputer —— 部署托管 agent 最简单的方式。
zh.why_good: 部署托管 agent 最简单的方式——团队把 agent 从笔记本搬到生产时的真实痛点。
zh.value: 按量的托管 agent 主机(agent 版 Vercel 赛道);团队为不用自己跑 agent 基础设施 付费。
zh.risk: 托管 agent 主机很挤(E2B、Modal、各实验室);要赢得靠可靠性 + 体验 + 规模化价格。
